import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class CF_723B {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String s = sc.next();

        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("\\([a-zA-Z_]*\\)").matcher(s);
        StringBuffer sb = new StringBuffer();
        while (m.find()) {
            m.appendReplacement(sb, "_");
        }
        m.appendTail(sb);
        String replaced = sb.toString();

        int maxLen = Pattern.compile("_+").splitAsStream(replaced)
                .mapToInt(String::length)
                .max()
                .orElse(0);
        System.out.println(maxLen);

        System.out.println(countWordsInParentheses(s));
    }

    static int countWordsInParentheses(String s) {
        int words = 0;
        boolean open = false;
        int start = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(') {
                open = true;
                start = i;
            } else if (open && c == ')') {
                open = false;
                words += countWords(s.substring(start + 1, i));
            }
        }
        return words;
    }

    static int countWords(String text) {
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }
        return (int) Pattern.compile("_+").splitAsStream(text)
                .filter(word -> !word.isEmpty())
                .count();
    }
}
